fstatic≥T

Tension, T=m1g

Frictional force, fstatic=μN=μ(m2+m)g

Equating the forces:
μ(m2+m)g≥m1g
μ(m2+m)≥m1

0.15(10+m)≥5

Given:



Mass m=150 g=0.15 kg



Initial velocity u=40 m/s, final velocity v=−60 m/s (since direction reverses)



Time t=5 ms=0.005 s



Step 1: Use impulse-momentum theorem

F=m(v−u)t=0.15(−60−40)0.005=0.15×(−100)0.005=−150.005=−3000 N

Magnitude of force = 3000 N
